Quoted Price and EMD/ Performance Security: (a) The Bidder shall quote unit rate which shall comprise of monthly remun eration, EPF, ESI & other statutory costs and Service Charges in the format of online quotation as shown on GeM Portal. The service charge should incl ude all charges/deductions to be made by the agency for its services and o ther liabilities but exclude mandatory charges of ESI & EPF etc. (b) Monthly remuneration will be accepted including all taxes and expense s, as per latest Central Govt./Govt. of Uttar Pradesh rates of minimum wag es whichever is higher. All the rates quoted should be applicable for area ‘ B’. (c) The rate quoted shall be fixed for the duration of the contract and shall not be subject to adjustment except the statutory provisions and VDA fied by the Ministry from time to time applicable for the supply of manpow er.

(d) In case of change in rates due to statutory provisions only such change will be accepted and not any additional liability i.e. % of profit/service char ge/s etc. As such bidder while submitting the bid should specifically, quote the rate etc. in this regard. (e) EMD as per calculation of GEM Portal in the form of an Account Pay ee Demand Draft, valid for 90 days after the date of submission of bids. Th e same may be drawn in favor of “VIDYALAYA VIKAS NIDHI ACCOUNT” payable at BAREILLY. (f) The bidder has to upload scan copy of Demand Draft along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the buyer within five days of bid end date/bid open date. EMD, DD must be uploaded with the bid on GEM Portal otherwise bid will be disqualified. (g) The selected firm has to furnish performance security in the form of Ba nk Guarantee for an amount of 3% of total value of tender valid up to the e nd of contract. The performance security shall be submitted within 10 days from the date of Notification of Award. The earnest money shall be returne d only after the performance security is submitted by the Contracting Agen cy. (h) In case, the contract is further extended beyond the initial period, t he performance security will have to be accordingly retained up to the ext ended period. The amount of performance security deposit may be revised by the authority considering the contractual obligation of the service provi der. (j) In case of breach of any terms and conditions attached to this agreeme nt, the performance security deposit of the service provider shall be liable t o be forfeited. (k) Each bidder must submit only one bid, complete in all respect attachin g all required documents/certificates at appropriate place.

(b) The remuneration to the engaged staff shall be disbursed by the agenc y into bank accounts of the engaged staff through RTGS/NEFT, after obtai ning authorization from engaged staff. (c) The contracting Agency will ensure payment by the 5 of every succe th eding month to their employees provided to the Vidyalaya as per the mont hly remuneration quoted without any deduction. (d) The Contracting Agency will submit the invoice/bill along with proof of disbursement in triplicate after making the payment to the employees prov ided to the Vidyalaya supported with the following documents:- (i) Details of disbursement made to the staff furnishing RTGS/NEFT details f or each payment. (ii) Copy of Electronic Challan Receipt (ECR) as an e-challan for KV proof of payment of statutory obligation such as EPF, ESI, Service Tax and any othe r applicable tax. (e) Payment to the contracting agency will be released within 15 days from the date of the receipt of the invoice/bill on fulfilment of required documen tation, subject to availability of funds in the Vidyalaya. (f) The contracting agency will provide Uniform, Identity Card with EPF/UA N and ESI numbers face mask, hand sanitizer and other items related to pr ecautions of COVID-19 pandemic to all his employees deputed as per the f ormat suggested by the Indenting Office for the period of contract.

(h) It is mandatory for the Contracting Agency to submit the attested copy of License obtained from Home Department, Govt. of Uttar Pradesh for run ning the business of private security agencies (PASARA Prarup-06) operatin g in Uttar Pradesh failing which the bid will be treated as disqualified/non r esponsive. (i) The normal office hours of the Vidyalaya is from 7.00 am to 4.00 pm six days from Monday to Saturday. (j) The contracting Agency will be required to sign a contract with the Vidy alaya as per the Model Contract provided by the Vidyalaya. The other term s and conditions specified in the Bid document and accepted bid will also fo rm the part of the Model Agreement. (k) In case of any loss/theft of property or assets of the Vidyalaya during th e contract period the Vidyalaya reserves the right to claim and recover da mages from Contracting Agency. The contracting agency will also ensure that the security guards/security supervisors are free from Aids/Covid-19 or any other infectious disease before deployment for work. (n) The contracting agency will necessarily submit a certificate from the co mpetent authority that training has been provided to the workers/firm offic ials.
